name: What are the critical steps for due diligence when purchasing a luxury condo?

mainEntity.name: What are the critical steps for due diligence when purchasing a luxury condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Critical due diligence steps for a luxury condo include thoroughly reviewing HOA documents, such as financial statements, meeting minutes, and reserve studies, to assess the building's financial health and any upcoming assessments. It's also essential to conduct a comprehensive home inspection, even for new construction, to identify any potential issues. Additionally, verifying the accuracy of listed amenities and features, understanding rental restrictions, and confirming insurance coverage are vital. We help clients navigate these complex document reviews to ensure a well-informed purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Due diligence for luxury condos involves reviewing HOA financials and documents, conducting a detailed home inspection, and verifying amenities and rental restrictions.
